title: Donald Knuth: Algorithms, Complexity, and The Art of Computer Programming | Lex Fridman Podcast #62
summary: Lex Fridman interviews Donald Knuth about algorithms, complexity, The Art of Computer Programming, and his work habits. The conversation covers his approach to verifying algorithms and how he organises his time.
why: Cited as an excellent look at Knuth's thinking and working style, and as a likely source for quotes about his habits.

quote.text: It's fascinating to learn how much energy he still spends at verifying and investigating each aspect of newly published algorithms.
